items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: So he gave me a couple of Phil Walls arrangements to look over. And, you know, Phil was a piano player on Kostelanetz' show and on this guy's show, and he used to make -- I heard one time that he had made 18 arrangements in one week.

ctx.x: He didn't want me to do that anymore. So he gave me a couple of Phil Walls arrangements to look over. And, you know, Phil was a piano player on Kostelanetz' show and on this guy's show, and he used to make -- I heard one time that he had made 18 arrangements in one week.
